sol-3-1.summary: A closing-rule tail before U+2028 or U+2029 inside a quoted attribute lets render succeed with a block that parsing rejects as orphanedEnd, allowing sync to write an unreadable file.
sol-3-1.fix: Before render succeeds, verify markerMatches recognizes the synthesized BEGIN marker in full with BEGIN kind, the declared identity and exactly the declared attributes; otherwise return the existing typed invalidAttribute refusal before any write. Preserve ordinary Unicode attributes and linear scanner behavior. Add hash/HTML regressions for U+2028 and U+2029 in SectionDialect.test.ts, retaining ordinary Unicode round trips, and a ManagedSection.test.ts sync regression proving typed refusal and preservation of existing file bytes.
